title: Building Production-Grade Agents
description: Take a support agent for the fictional store Parcelpine from a one-hour demo to a release you can trust: launch-day triage, eval gates, tools, context and memory, retrieval, orchestration, security and a local release pipeline. Code in Python, JavaScript or Java for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and DeepSeek; every lesson has a reader, a runnable lab and an interview hub.
author: Vinod Seth
